I rebooked 15 of the 19 passengers. The 4 passengers on booking PD9X3K are still on ZX 440, because no connection had room for all of them together.

Every group kept its cabin and travelled together. I handled the groups in priority order and gave each one the earliest-arriving connection that still had enough seats in each of its cabins:

| Priority | Booking (from) | Passengers | Rebooked onto | Arrives JFK, 9 Nov |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | WN4R8C (FRA) | 1 Business, 2 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 via Amsterdam | 18:40 |
| 2 | HB3K9W (MUC) | 1 Business, 1 Economy | ZX 474 → ZX 472 via Amsterdam | 18:40 |
| 3 | LM2Q7H (FRA) | 2 Business | ZX 494 → ZX 490 via Boston | 20:25 |
| 4 | EK1V7P (MUC) | 1 Business | ZX 454 → ZX 462 via London | 21:55 |
| 5 | PD9X3K (FRA) | 4 Economy | **Not rebooked**, still on ZX 440 | – |
| 6 | OR6M2D (MUC) | 3 Economy | ZX 454 → ZX 460 via London | 17:55 |
| 7 | CB8T4F (FRA) | 2 Economy | ZX 494 → ZX 490 via Boston | 20:25 |
| 8 | SV5J1N (FRA) | 1 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 via Amsterdam | 18:40 |

- **Why some groups don't get the earliest flight:** the earliest connection from each airport arrives at 17:55, but it has no free Business seats on the London–New York leg. That's why the Business groups went on later flights.
- **Why PD9X3K was left:** when its turn came, no Frankfurt connection had 4 free Economy seats on every flight. That includes the next-day and 11 November options, which had at most 3.

ANSWER: PD9X3K

1. Everyone keeps their cabin.
2. Passengers with the same booking reference travel together on the same flights. Never split a booking group.
3. Seats go to the booking groups by priority, one list for both flights: groups that include a Business passenger first; then larger groups before smaller ones; then by booking reference, alphabetically.
4. Each group gets the connection that arrives in New York earliest and has enough free seats in each of its passengers' cabins on every flight, after all higher-priority groups have their seats. If two such connections arrive at the same time, take the one with fewer changes.
5. If no connection has room for a whole group, leave that group on its cancelled flight.

You may make the bookings in any order.

End your reply with one line in the form `ANSWER: <booking references left on their cancelled flight, comma-separated, or NONE>`.

content.thinking: Checking PD9X3K for any available FRA connection with 4E availability across its legs—going through each flight pairing and confirming none have the needed seat class open, so this booking genuinely had no alternative option.

content.text:
I rebooked 15 of the 19 passengers. The 4 passengers on booking PD9X3K are still on ZX 440, because no connection had room for all of them together.

Every group kept its cabin and travelled together. I handled the groups in priority order and gave each one the earliest-arriving connection that still had enough seats in each of its cabins:

| Priority | Booking (from) | Passengers | Rebooked onto | Arrives JFK, 9 Nov |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | WN4R8C (FRA) | 1 Business, 2 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 via Amsterdam | 18:40 |
| 2 | HB3K9W (MUC) | 1 Business, 1 Economy | ZX 474 → ZX 472 via Amsterdam | 18:40 |
| 3 | LM2Q7H (FRA) | 2 Business | ZX 494 → ZX 490 via Boston | 20:25 |
| 4 | EK1V7P (MUC) | 1 Business | ZX 454 → ZX 462 via London | 21:55 |
| 5 | PD9X3K (FRA) | 4 Economy | **Not rebooked**, still on ZX 440 | – |
| 6 | OR6M2D (MUC) | 3 Economy | ZX 454 → ZX 460 via London | 17:55 |
| 7 | CB8T4F (FRA) | 2 Economy | ZX 494 → ZX 490 via Boston | 20:25 |
| 8 | SV5J1N (FRA) | 1 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 via Amsterdam | 18:40 |

- **Why some groups don't get the earliest flight:** the earliest connection from each airport arrives at 17:55, but it has no free Business seats on the London–New York leg. That's why the Business groups went on later flights.
- **Why PD9X3K was left:** when its turn came, no Frankfurt connection had 4 free Economy seats on every flight. That includes the next-day and 11 November options, which had at most 3.

ANSWER: PD9X3K
